description: Spring Boot Log4Shell reachability case study. Both applications carry log4j-core 2.14.1 at runtime. Only spring-log4shell passes request input to a Log4j logger.

build.command: mvn -q -DskipTests package && mvn -q dependency:copy-dependencies -DincludeScope=compile -DoutputDirectory=target/sbom-jars && mvn -q dependency:copy-dependencies -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/runtime-jars

apps.name: spring-log4shell
apps.note: The controller logs the input request parameter with LogManager, so JndiLookup is reachable from the request path.

apps.name: spring-nolog
apps.note: The controller accepts input but never logs. Plain CHA still reports JndiLookup as reachable, while RTA does not.
